description: Small labeled benchmark for ResearchForge. Categories match docs/EVALUATION.md. Every question is designed to run fully offline against the mock providers.

questions.query: Compare the current approaches to building AI coding agents, including tool-use patterns and memory strategies.
Compare vector databases for retrieval-augmented generation workloads.
What does current research say about the mechanisms behind CRISPR gene editing off-target effects?
What were the primary causes of the fall of the Western Roman Empire according to historians?
What are the trade-offs between event-driven and request-response architectures for microservices?
Summarize recent developments in open-weight large language models and their benchmark performance.
